scientific_integrity: The existing sharp sphere bound and conjugacy are acknowledged as published; the added theorem is the full equality classification and enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The all-alphabet classification holds only for exactly two sequential length-two palindromic or reverse-complement duplications; it is not a maximum-codebook result or a classification at higher error counts or other block lengths. Independent audit and external priority certification have not been performed.
title: All maximizers of two-step length-two palindromic-duplication spheres
